title: Bolalar kiyimi: yosh emas, bo'y
caption: 📏 Bolalar kiyimi: yoshga emas, bo'yga qarang H&M va Uniqlo bolalar o'lchamini santimetrda — bo'y bo'yicha yozadi. «7 yosh» degan yorliq hammaga mos kelmaydi: bir sinfdagi bolalar bo'yi 15–20 sm farq qiladi. 📐 Qanday o'lchash kerak 1. Bolani poyabzalsiz devorga yondashtirib turg'izing 2. Boshi ustiga kitob qo'yib, devorga belgi qo'ying 3. Poldan belgigacha — bu bo'y (sm) 👕 H&M bolalar o'lchami (bo'y, sm) • 110–116 sm — taxminan 4–6 yosh • 122–128 sm — taxminan 6–8 yosh • 134–140 sm — taxminan 8–10 yosh • 146–152 sm — taxminan 10–12 yosh Uniqlo'da: 110, 120, 130, 140, 150 — bu ham bo'y (sm). 💡 Maslahat • Bo'yi ikki o'lcham orasida bo'lsa — kattasini oling • Kurtka va qishki kiyimga 5–6 sm «o'sish zaxirasi» qo'shing • Gap / Old Navy XS–L harflarini ishlatadi — jadvalidan sm ustunini toping ⚠️ Jadval taxminiy — har doim do'konning o'z o'lcham jadvalini tekshiring. 📲 O'lcham qo'llanmalari — ilovada ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #olcham
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#olcham".
2) Center: a child's height chart drawn on a wall like a ruler with centimetre marks (110, 120, 130, 140), a small folded kids' jacket and a tiny sneaker at its base, and a book resting flat on top of an imaginary head line. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of sky blue (#38BDF8); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Bolalar kiyimi: yosh emas, bo'y"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "O'lchamni santimetrda tanlang"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: O'lcham va yosh mosligi taxminiy (H&M bolalar o'lchamlari bo'y bo'yicha). H&M/Uniqlo sahifalari Claude muhitidan ochilmadi — jadvalni do'kon saytida tekshiring.
